title: Savchuk
summary: Savchuk is a Ukrainian surname that is prevalent in several countries, including Poland, Israel, Russia, and the United States. The name is associated with various notable individuals, particularly in the fields of sports and the arts, many of whom have Ukrainian heritage.

sections.heading: Ukrainian Notables
paragraphs: Anastasiya Savchuk (born 1996) is recognized as a [[ukrainian|Ukrainian]] synchronized swimmer.
Boris Savchuk (1943–1996) was a Ukrainian sprinter known for his contributions to athletics.
Hlib Savchuk (born 2003) is a Ukrainian football player who represents the nation's sporting talent.
Olga Savchuk (born 1987) is a Ukrainian tennis player who has competed internationally.
Valentyna Savchuk (born 1975) is a Ukrainian race walker, contributing to the country's presence in athletics.
Vladyslav Savchuk (born 1979) is another Ukrainian footballer, adding to the list of athletes with this surname.

sections.heading: International Variants
paragraphs: The surname Savchuk has several variations, including Sawchuk and Sawczuk, which are found in different cultural contexts.
Alexander Sawchuk (born 1945) is an American electrical engineer with roots linked to this surname.
Bill Sawchuk (born 1959) is a Canadian swimmer, showcasing the name's presence in sports outside [[ukraine|Ukraine]].
Gavin Sawchuk (born 2003) is an American football player, while Kim Sawchuk (born 1960) is a Canadian academic.
Michael Sawchuk (1911–1969) served as a Canadian politician, indicating the surname's involvement in governance.
Riley Sawchuk (born 1999) is a Canadian ice hockey forward, and Terry Sawchuk (1929–1970) was a renowned Canadian ice hockey goaltender.
Piotr Sawczuk (born 1962) is a Polish Roman Catholic bishop, reflecting the surname's presence in religious contexts.
